name: Nightmare x sisters Ω ~Shuumatsu no Requiem~
original_name: Nightmare×sisters Ω ～終末のレクイエム～
source:
Setsuna, Yuuka, and Rinne, who had been continuing their battle against the Demon Cult, were undergoing rigorous training in preparation for their next battle, aiming to level up even further.

Just then, they heard that the cult leader, who could be called the root of all evil, had begun to move again, so they decided to return after finishing their training.
They joined forces with Kuon and Rei, who had fought the revived cult leader over the sacred sword Amagumo no Tsurugi, and finally began their campaign to destroy the cult.

Just as they were about to move forward, the cult leader, who had obtained the Amagumo no Tsurugi, vanished once again, leaving them with the urgent task of locating his whereabouts.

Setsuna, who had to wait until the whereabouts of the cult leader were known, proposed that they all live together in preparation for the decisive battle.
There was a family dormitory in the city where the headquarters of the church to which Setsuna and the others belonged was located, so they decided to start living together.

Even as they spend their days in temporary peace, the Setsuna group continues to prepare for the impending decisive battle.  
Georgi, the elite exorcist who accompanied the Setsuna group on their training, will also lend his strength, and the momentum for the defeat of the cult leader grows stronger...

Despite various accidents along the way, they gradually move closer to the final showdown with the help of Chisei and others they met at the academy.

What awaits them at the end is either the exorcism of the evil demon or an endless cycle of torment.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Sisters_Omega/]official site[/url]]
translation:
继续与魔教战斗的刹那、优香和凛音，正在接受严格的训练，为下一场战斗做准备，目标是更上一层楼。

就在这时，他们听说那个堪称万恶之源的邪教教主又开始活动了，所以他们决定结束训练后返回。
他们与凭借圣剑天云剑与复活的邪教领袖久远和丽联手，最终开始了消灭邪教的战役。

正当他们准备继续前行时，获得天云剑的邪教教主却再次消失，让他们面临着寻找他下落的紧迫任务。

必须等到教主下落得知的刹那提议大家住在一起，准备决战。
刹那等人所在的教会总部所在的城市里有一个家庭宿舍，所以他们决定开始一起生活。

尽管他们过着暂时和平的日子，刹那集团仍在继续为即将到来的决战做准备。
陪伴刹那一行人训练的精锐驱魔师格奥尔基也将伸出力量，打败邪教领袖的势头愈发强劲……

尽管一路上发生了各种意外，但在学院遇到的智生等人的帮助下，他们逐渐接近了最终的对决。

最终等待他们的，要么是邪魔的驱魔，要么是无尽的轮回折磨。

[翻译自[url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Sisters_Omega/]官方网站[/url]]
